creator: Alexander Terp
description: Follow-up to a_2hIfvs1Cc, designed and not built (2026-11-11). Today the person is told of a long block only when a message waits on the pane, or the pane is a helper; otherwise only the one-time [notifications] blocked banner says so. Design from the worker: a non-helper pane at a dialog for 2 hours with nothing unread is told to the person once, with no setting (2 hours is longer than anyone at the window leaves a dialog they can see), skipping a pane the stall rule already told them about. Uses notices::tell_the_person.
title: Tell the person of a pane blocked for hours with nothing unread
